alerts.title: Jammu-Srinagar Highway (NH-44) shut again as fresh landslides, shooting stones hit Ramban-Banihal stretch
alerts.summary: NH-44 remains closed to all traffic as continuous rainfall triggers fresh landslides, shooting stones and slushy road conditions near Dawal Bridge (Udhampur) and Gangroo (Ramban). Authorities have barred vehicles from proceeding beyond Nagrota on the Jammu side and Qazigund on the Srinagar side while restoration crews clear debris — the second closure spell in under a week.
alerts.impact: Kashmir Valley pincodes (Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag) remain effectively cut off by road — hold NS flags and extend TAT tolerance for Valley hubs; pre-build buffer stock at the Jammu hub for whenever the highway reopens.

alerts.title: 108+ roads still blocked across Himachal Pradesh as IMD extends heavy-rain alert to Aug 4
alerts.summary: 108 roads remain closed across Himachal Pradesh — 39 in Mandi, 33 in Kullu, 11 in Shimla, 9 in Sirmaur, 7 in Chamba and 5 in Kangra — after torrential rain damage; 9 transformers and 38 water-supply schemes are also disrupted. IMD has issued an orange alert for Kangra/Mandi/Chamba and yellow alert for Shimla/Kullu/Sirmaur, with isolated heavy rain expected through Aug 7.
alerts.impact: FM linehaul into hill hubs (Shimla, Mandi, Kullu) faces repeated single-lane or no-access windows through the week — hold flexible SLAs and avoid new dispatch commitments to blocked-road pincodes until district lists clear.

alerts.title: Landslide shuts NH-2 Kohima-Mao stretch daily 6am-6pm, cutting key Nagaland-Manipur link
alerts.summary: Active sliding debris at the Phesama sinking zone on NH-2 (Kohima-Mao section, Km 191.8-192.1) has forced district authorities to close the stretch daily from 6am-6pm for restoration work — the only major highway link between Nagaland and Manipur.
alerts.impact: Expect daytime transit delays for Dimapur/Kohima-Imphal linehaul; schedule FM dispatches for the overnight open window and flag partial-day SLA relaxation for Manipur-bound shipments routed via this corridor.

alerts.title: Assam, Arunachal Pradesh & Nagaland flood-and-landslide toll rises; PM Modi pledges Central aid
alerts.summary: Heavy monsoon rain through Aug 1 kept Assam, Arunachal Pradesh and Nagaland under IMD orange alerts for flash floods and landslides. Nearly 1.5 lakh people are affected in Arunachal Pradesh, at least 8 deaths reported in Nagaland's Mon district, and PM Modi has reviewed the damage and pledged Central assistance while floodwaters recede in several areas.
alerts.impact: Maintain NS flags for the worst-hit Assam/Arunachal pincodes and monitor Guwahati hub inbound linehaul; coordinate contingency LM capacity with Delhivery/Xpressbees for alternate Northeast routing.

alerts.title: Rajasthan truckers' indefinite strike over VLTD costs grounds 10,000+ trucks
alerts.summary: The Rajasthan Truck Transport Sangharsh Samiti has kept over 10,000 trucks off the road in an indefinite strike against VLTD costs (₹25,000-30,000 in Rajasthan vs ₹3,000-3,500 in neighbouring states), permit hurdles, fitness-renewal rules and e-detection challans. Associations warn of disruption to steel, cement, grocery and agri-produce movement if talks with the state government fail.
alerts.impact: Expect FM linehaul delays out of Jaipur, Jodhpur and Kota hubs; line up alternate 3P capacity or inter-state rerouting for Rajasthan-bound dispatches and pre-position buffer stock at bordering hubs.

alerts.title: South India VLTD strike deadline (Aug 1) passes with on-ground implementation unconfirmed
alerts.summary: Truck owners' associations across six southern states had threatened an indefinite strike from Aug 1 over VLTD/panic-button mandates and toll costs. As of Aug 2 there is no confirmed independent reporting of a full walkout, but the underlying VLTD dispute — mirrored by Rajasthan's active strike — remains unresolved nationally and could still escalate.
alerts.impact: Treat as a live risk, not yet a confirmed disruption: keep contingency buffer and alternate-LM plans ready for Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hubs; re-verify ground status with 3P partners daily before relaxing precautions.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra: Delhi-Haridwar highway and Delhi-Meerut Expressway to bar heavy vehicles Aug 4-12
alerts.summary: Delhi Police and UP authorities will restrict heavy-vehicle movement on the Delhi-Haridwar National Highway and Ganga Canal road from Aug 4, and close the UP stretch of the Delhi-Meerut Expressway to regular traffic entirely from Aug 7-12, reserving lanes for Kanwar Yatra pilgrims through the yatra's Aug 11 conclusion.
alerts.impact: Reroute FM linehaul between Delhi NCR and the Haridwar/Meerut/Dehradun corridor around the restriction window; build 3-4 days of transit buffer for affected pincodes and expect rider-mobility slowdowns on connecting roads through Aug 12.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel hold at multi-city highs for 10th straight week; LPG/CNG unchanged
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain steady since OMCs' May 25 hike — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20 (petrol/diesel), Mumbai ₹111.21/₹99.82, with diesel above ₹99 in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Kolkata. LPG, CNG and PNG rates are unchanged for over a month.
alerts.impact: No immediate LM/FM disruption; sustained elevated fuel levels keep pressure on 3P per-km rates — track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel-surcharge asks ahead of the next pricing cycle.
